# Monetization

The tiers below are a proposed business model only. Billing, entitlements, accounts, sharing, and server
sync are not implemented. The current prototype exposes local functionality without plan enforcement.

## Free

- offline
- network throttling
- basic failures

## Pro

- unlimited scenarios
- recorder
- reports
- advanced mutations

## Team

- shared scenarios
- GitHub integration
- Jira integration
- CI integration
